outages.headline: South Korea refiners eye Venezuelan crude amid Hormuz disruptions
outages.summary: South Korea’s four major oil refiners are exploring imports of Venezuelan crude oil as Middle East conflicts disrupt shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, according to a Korea Petroleum Association official. GS Caltex imported 110,000 barrels of Venezuelan crude in June to test its quality, the official said. The refiner will assess whether the crude ...
